scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/clean-coverage.mjs && vitest run --coverage && COVERAGE=true playwright test && node scripts/report-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:backend: uv run --directory backend pytest --cov=app --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=90 --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=json:../reports/backend-coverage.json && node scripts/report-backend-coverage.mjs && uv run --directory backend ruff check app tests
scripts.test:release: npm run build && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:backend && node scripts/update-validation-docs.mjs
